verdict.rationale: Spline offers webhooks and a Real-time API that let a published scene 'automatically trigger actions, update variables, and react to data sent from external sources' without a person driving it (spline-docs-9, spline-docs-10, spline-docs-26), which is a form of event-driven automation running unattended. However, this is scene-level reactivity to external events, not a general-purpose scheduled/autonomous agent workflow — the AI Agent and MCP integrations require an open editor tab and active AI-tool session (spline-docs-13, spline-docs-25) rather than running independently in the background. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduled/cron-like autonomous tasks, independent confirmation of webhook automation working in practice, and any agentic workflow that persists without an open editor session.
